informal_statement: For \(R>0\), \(c\mapsto H(c,R)/c\) is strictly decreasing on \((0,\min(1,R))\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:1640-1654`: For fixed \(R>0\) the formal density interval is exactly \((0,\min (1,R))\). The factor \(R/c^2\) is positive and \(L\) negative there; the author neither includes density zero nor extends beyond \(c<R\).
